welcome.title: You can now vote in the Tequiniela 2026
welcome.description: The Tequiniela is a pool organized among friends for the Oscars 2026 ceremony. To participate, sign in with your Google account, select your nominees, and don't forget to check the rules.

login.title: Sign In
login.instructions: To register your votes, sign in with your Google account.
login.publicNotice: Your account name and profile photo will be displayed publicly.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: The Oscars ceremony will take place on <bold>Sunday, March 15, 2026</bold>. During the event, we will update the results as soon as they are announced, and this ranking will be updated according to the participants' results.
ranking.scoring: Each correct pick per category equals <bold>1 point</bold>. The ranking will sort users by the number of accumulated points. In case of a tie, the user who registered first will be the winner.

winners.title: Winners
winners.noData: No data available for this year.

rules.title: Rules
rules.welcome: Welcome to the traditional Oscars pool!
rules.joinFun: Join the fun and compete with other movie fans to see who has the sharpest eye for picking the winners.
rules.forEveryone: It doesn't matter if you're a seasoned cinephile or just a casual viewer, the pool is for everyone!
rules.getReady: Get ready to enjoy a night full of surprises, celebrities and great awards, and show your skills picking the Oscar winners in the Tequiniela!
